title: Unpaid Overtime / Expose
description: An ally needs help away from the main operation. This offer closes in three career days.
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: A small service survives because someone chose to maintain it.

lore.title: Unpaid Overtime / Expose / Unsent message
lore.text: RHEA / public archivist: An ally needs help away from the main operation. This offer closes in three career days. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.
